events.summary: Tang Wei, in Kanyou with both fifty-man Tang Champion companies under Duan Jin and Shen Rui, advances toward the Qin military authority handling Ouki's requested preliminary command-qualification review while keeping all one hundred private House Tang veterans together and visible as far as lawful Qin protocol permits. He does not claim Qin office or command, and he stops the retinue wherever lawful protocol requires rather than forcing access.

Tang Wei personally seeks to present Ouki's preliminary command-qualification summons through the first lawful Qin military receiving channel available to him in Kanyou. Both Tang Champion companies remain together under Duan Jin and Shen Rui behind him, still private House Tang troops under Tang Wei's command. Tang Wei claims no Qin office, does not force access, and asks to be directed to the authority handling Ouki's requested review.

Tang Wei presents himself through Ouki's staff channel and proceeds with the preliminary command-qualification review under the receiving staff's lawful procedure, continuing through routine formalities and stopping before any new consequential voluntary choice, appointment, oath, commitment, spending decision, troop transfer, or irreversible escalation.

sword-interaction-attempt.v1 {"action":"present","actor_id":"char_tang_wei","formation_refs":[],"player_statement":"I move now. The scouts being overdue is a warning, not proof of the enemy main body, so I will not freeze the column or split the infantry. The main body takes the southern road at a controlled fighting pace because the crossing deadline governs the mission. Fifty cavalry remain close as counter-reconnaissance and flank screen; a small relay detachment rides only far enough to recover contact with the missing patrols or bring back their signs, with a fixed return time. Wagons stay in the center, the van clears danger points before the column enters them, and if contact appears, the screen delays and reports rather than chasing. sword-interaction-attempt.v1 {"action":"present","actor_id":"char_tang_wei","formation_refs":[],"player_statement":"Keep the column moving. sword-interaction-attempt.v1 {"action":"present","actor_id":"char_tang_wei","formation_refs":[],"player_statement":"I do not put the wagons into ground I have not first secured. Halt the baggage and main body outside the constriction, where the formation still has room to fight or reverse. The cavalry screen keeps the enemy horse at distance and reports any attempt to close. The van goes forward on foot in mutually supporting elements: clear the road, seize both rocky shoulders from the near side, and work forward until the heights and the far exit are observed. Do not chase beyond the ground. If there is resistance, fix it and report rather than feeding the column into an uncertain fight. If the heights and exit are clear, the main body passes through at once in controlled sequence; infantry holds the shoulders until the last wagon is through, then rejoins. I will spend only the time needed to remove the terrain's ambush advantage, not enough to surrender the crossing deadline.","posture":null,"process_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","request_id":"req_r35_ouki_review_answer_secure_constriction_20260814_0033","schema":"sword-interaction-attempt.v1","surface_digest":"bd2fff219e9f3b15b5283811817109556d98d51bc8364d63acf76e2f2ad91acc","target_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","world_response_status":"not_established_by_attempt"}

sword-interaction-attempt.v1 {"action":"present","actor_id":"char_tang_wei","formation_refs":[],"player_statement":"I refuse to let them turn this into two separate fights. The wagons and the bulk of the infantry remain outside the constriction, where they still have room to maneuver. Reinforce the van until roughly two hundred infantry are committed forward. Hold the near shoulder, fix the eighty men on the far height, and attack to seize that height and the far exit; the objective is the ground, not pursuit. If they withdraw, occupy the shoulder and stop. At the rear, stiffen the cavalry screen with a formed infantry rear guard at the mouth of the constriction. The horse continues yielding by bounds and falls back through that infantry if the enemy cavalry presses close; it does not countercharge merely to relieve pressure. The remaining infantry stays with the wagons as reserve and can reinforce either face. I allow one deliberate attempt to clear the far shoulder, not repeated uphill attrition. If the blocking force is substantially reinforced or cannot be cleared promptly, we disengage while the baggage is still outside the choke and reverse route. If the height falls, both shoulders are held while the wagons pass immediately, then the covering infantry rejoins. The mission is to get the column through on time, not to destroy every enemy element that tries to delay it.","posture":null,"process_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","request_id":"req_r36_ouki_review_answer_two_front_control_20260814_0037","schema":"sword-interaction-attempt.v1","surface_digest":"86f5eaf6de1c695210a133aad81333e9a202c3fca935c41463a18c632c37f5c9","target_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","world_response_status":"not_established_by_attempt"}

sword-interaction-attempt.v1 {"action":"present","actor_id":"char_tang_wei","formation_refs":[],"player_statement":"I race for the crossing, but I do not send an unsupported detachment blindly into it. The twenty-five returned cavalry go forward at once as reconnaissance: stay out of decisive contact, keep the withdrawing eighty and the larger body under observation, and report whether the crossing itself is still open. Most of the infantry already beyond the constriction moves directly toward the crossing as the advance guard; only the minimum needed remains on the two shoulders until the wagons have passed. The main body starts through immediately behind them. The rear guard and the original cavalry screen continue to contain the horse behind us and refuse pursuit or a separate battle. Once the baggage clears, the shoulder guards fall in and the column closes toward the crossing. If the crossing is still open, the advance guard takes it and holds for the main body. If the scouts report that a substantially stronger enemy has already occupied it, the advance guard stops short and fixes their position rather than attacking piecemeal until the main body closes. The withdrawing eighty are not the objective; the crossing is. I use our shorter distance to arrive first in useful strength, while keeping every detachment tied to the same mission.","posture":null,"process_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","request_id":"req_r37_ouki_review_answer_race_crossing_20260814_0041","schema":"sword-interaction-attempt.v1","surface_digest":"2f45a746f390f493ef3538ef1e931789354de9cd8a087e0680330387a4d90e1b","target_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","world_response_status":"not_established_by_attempt"}

sword-interaction-attempt.v1 {"action":"present","actor_id":"char_tang_wei","formation_refs":[],"player_statement":"I seize the southern bank with fighting troops, not with the baggage. The advance infantry crosses now in formed waves and establishes a compact bridgehead around the far end of the ford. The twenty-five returned cavalry stays ahead and to the flanks as reconnaissance; it watches the approaching three hundred eighty infantry and fifty cavalry and does not charge them. As the main body's infantry reaches the northern bank, I keep feeding infantry across until the southern bridgehead is strong enough to receive the enemy without being isolated, while retaining a formed reserve on the northern bank. The wagons do not enter the water yet. Behind them, the rear guard and the original fifty cavalry continue containing the following horse and fall back in order as the column closes on the ford. If the enemy reaches the southern bank before I have enough strength across, the forward troops stop extending, hold close enough to the ford to be reinforced continuously, and deny the enemy the crossing approaches rather than attacking outnumbered. Once the enemy is checked or fixed away from the ford and the southern bank is secure, the wagons cross immediately under cover. We arrived first; I turn that time advantage into a reinforced bridgehead and continuous passage, not into a divided baggage train or a passive wait that lets the enemy occupy the far bank.","posture":null,"process_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","request_id":"req_r39_ouki_review_answer_ford_bridgehead_20260814_0051","schema":"sword-interaction-attempt.v1","surface_digest":"dc994a387a853b7ea2495677cb6118181fca1edaaa2aa49df18848367300218f","target_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","world_response_status":"not_established_by_attempt"}

sword-interaction-attempt.v1 {"action":"present","actor_id":"char_tang_wei","formation_refs":[],"player_statement":"I do not chase the turning force, and I do not strip the northern bank before the rear closes. The three hundred infantry south of the ford contract into a compact bridgehead anchored on the crossing. The front holds the enemy three hundred; the western side refuses its flank rather than stretching after the eighty infantry and fifty cavalry. The twenty-five cavalry screen that western movement, stay out of a cavalry fight, and report any attempt to pass behind the bridgehead. The hundred infantry on the northern bank remain with the baggage until the rear hundred infantry and fifty cavalry actually reach the ford. As soon as that rear force closes, the northern hundred cross and become the western reserve, while the arriving rear hundred take over protection of the wagons and northern ford mouth. That gives me four hundred infantry south without leaving the baggage uncovered for an instant. If the turning force presses, the western reserve meets its infantry in formed order and denies the cavalry a loose flank to exploit; there is no pursuit beyond what is needed to protect the crossing. If the enemy main body attacks before the relief is complete, the bridgehead contracts around the ford and the northern reserve does not cross until its replacement is in position. Once the southern position is stable, the wagons begin passing under cover. I preserve the crossing, keep one connected battle, and make their flank movement consume time instead of making me divide myself to answer it.","posture":null,"process_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","request_id":"req_r40_ouki_review_answer_phased_relief_20260814_0055","schema":"sword-interaction-attempt.v1","surface_digest":"19f0eacf9fec2f5913479c7d98d6cff0e1339ebf213a1fd7268feae700903863","target_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","world_response_status":"not_established_by_attempt"}

sword-interaction-attempt.v1 {"action":"present","actor_id":"char_tang_wei","formation_refs":[],"player_statement":"We attack, but we do not attack everywhere at once. Stop feeding new wagons into the ford; clear the wagons already in the water onto the southern bank and keep the remaining baggage north under the hundred infantry and fifty cavalry. South of the ford, two hundred infantry hold the enemy three hundred in a compact fixing front anchored on the crossing. The other two hundred mass against the western eighty infantry. The twenty-five cavalry screen outside that attack, watching the enemy fifty cavalry and denying them an open route behind our infantry rather than trying to beat them horse against horse. The western two hundred attack the eighty infantry hard and together. Their objective is to break or drive that infantry away from our flank, not to pursue it. As soon as the western threat is displaced, those troops pivot back into the flank of the enemy three hundred while the fixing front advances, turning the fight into one concentrated attack. If the enemy three hundred launches a full assault before the western blow succeeds, the fixing front gives ground only toward the ford while staying formed, buying time for the western force to finish or disengage and rejoin. North of the ford, the baggage guard holds position and refuses the following cavalry any opening into the crossing. We use local superiority to destroy the smaller tactical problem first, then roll that superiority into the main body; the ford remains our anchor and our line of reinforcement throughout.","posture":null,"process_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","request_id":"req_r42_ouki_review_answer_attack_western_wing_20260814_0102","schema":"sword-interaction-attempt.v1","surface_digest":"cd74b7e3366433d5e17491d32e8df9f7a698e264d2f14b60f86d4a5b9d05989a","target_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","world_response_status":"not_established_by_attempt"}

sword-interaction-attempt.v1 {"action":"present","actor_id":"char_tang_wei","formation_refs":[],"player_statement":"The mission comes first. We have already forced the enemy off the crossing, so I do not spend that advantage on an unnecessary pursuit. Resume the crossing immediately in controlled sequence. South of the ford, three hundred infantry face the road and cover the withdrawal direction while one hundred remain close to the southern ford mouth as reserve and crossing security. The twenty-five cavalry shadow the withdrawing enemy at distance, report any attempt to turn back or occupy ground ahead, and do not become decisively engaged. North of the ford, the hundred infantry and fifty cavalry keep the baggage moving and hold the following horse away from the entrance. Wagons cross continuously; no unit leaves its covering task merely to chase. As the final wagons clear, the northern infantry follows across, and the fifty cavalry are last over after screening the rear. Once the whole column is south of the water, I reform all five hundred infantry around the baggage with the seventy-five available cavalry divided between forward reconnaissance and rear security. The missing patrol remains missing and is not counted on. If the retreating force turns back before the crossing is complete, the southern covering force holds them away from the ford while the passage continues; if they keep withdrawing, we let them go. The stated mission is to reach and secure this crossing on time with the column fit to continue. Once the last wagon and rear guard are across and the column is reformed, the mission is complete. I do not turn success into a pursuit for its own sake.","posture":null,"process_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","request_id":"req_r43_ouki_review_answer_finish_mission_20260814_0106","schema":"sword-interaction-attempt.v1","surface_digest":"e685df07731b0ed305d8067daf95d56b50f8f1e8644d8abf550b4d797b98a2be","target_ref":"event_ouki_preliminary_review_response_001","world_response_status":"not_established_by_attempt"}
